title: Randomized hidden-clique reduction to near-optimal (one-half minus eta) approximate Nash equilibrium
author: Per Austrin, Mark Braverman, and Eden Chlamtac
work: Inapproximability of NP-Complete Variants of Nash Equilibrium
source_version: Theory of Computing volume 9 article 3 (2013), official complete journal PDF acquired 2026-09-30; canonical DOI 10.4086/toc.2013.v009a003 verified against official landing and printed PDF header
difficulty_reason: After named Chernoff and dense-subgraph-to-hidden-clique reconstruction inputs, the new randomized payoff-block reduction must rule out concentrated small supports, convert near-optimal payoff into mass inside the graph block, and extract a dense logarithmic bipartite subgraph from an approximate equilibrium. All generalized parameter inequalities and the complete small-support/density proof are supplied before the eta-dependent completeness/soundness closing. This is one H2 planted-clique reduction rather than an ordinary equilibrium existence or concentration exercise.

source_check.method: Root-approved native material plus fresh exact source0 union/body replay and26 primary/core bindings; no mathematical referee
source_check.note: Exact original formal Theorem3.7 only: for each eta>0 the randomized polynomial-time game construction maps a hidden clique of C ln n vertices to an exact equilibrium of maximum average payoff alpha, and every (1/2-eta)-equilibrium within delta=Omega(eta^2) of that payoff allows polynomial-time clique recovery, with the source high-probability convention. Complete payoff matrices, newly generalized dense-subgraph extraction, small-set mass proof, mass-in-A and conditional-value support are retained. The cited HK11 dense-bipartite-subgraph recovery theorem and Chernoff–Hoeffding remain named prerequisites. Small-support, second-equilibrium, Bayesian and other parameter regimes are unselected references and not counted. All-page source/output QA completed; exact final actual logs have zero missing-glyph/reference/citation/stability/box or other warning lines. Source-material candidate only, no admission/remote-delivery credit. Root admitted this exact original authored material as one H2 unit; source quirks retained unchanged.

root_decision.source_quirks_note: The original small-support probability expressions in its two original displays contain beta to the negative |S| power inside 1 minus that term. Native source and published proof preserve these exact signs; no exponent or probability-expression correction, counterexample analysis or mathematical-refereeing conclusion is supplied.
